name: On-chain demand confirms BTC trend — active-address growth cross-up on a positive-momentum BTC long
rationale: Thesis: real, settling on-chain demand should CONFIRM a price uptrend before it is fully priced. btc_active_addresses is a DRIFTING level (network adoption grows secularly), so a fitted level floor would be always-true — we use it ONLY as a cross_up event (a fresh acceleration in distinct addresses transacting, i.e. broad demand picking up). We require positive own-price momentum (ret_Nd) so we ride a trend the chain is confirming, not a dead network burst with no price follow-through. Disconfirmer 1: if dropping the active-address cross_up entirely and keeping only ret_Nd>mom_floor yields an equal-or-better deflated Sharpe, the on-chain term adds no orthogonal information and the 'edge' is just momentum. Disconfirmer 2: address counts and price co-move; if replacing cross_up with a plain level filter (impossible here by rule, so the ablation is: shuffle the on-chain series' timing by a random lag) matches the Sharpe, the timing of the cross is irrelevant and the signal is spurious. Spot-only, long-only.
catalyst: btc_active_addresses crosses up through its growth threshold while BTC price momentum is positive
